name: Button
summary: 用于触发即时操作，通过主题、变体、尺寸、形状和状态表达动作层级。
behavior: 一个操作区只保留一个最强主操作
异步提交时使用 loading 状态阻止重复触发
accessibility: 仅图标按钮提供可访问名称
键盘焦点状态必须可见
do: 根据动作层级选择主题和变体
让按钮文字描述操作结果
dont: 不要在同一区域堆叠多个主按钮
不要仅依赖颜色说明危险操作

en.summary: Triggers immediate actions, expressing hierarchy through theme, variant, size, shape, and state.
behavior: Keep one strongest primary action in an action area
Use loading state during async submission to prevent duplicate triggers
accessibility: Give icon-only buttons an accessible name
do: Choose theme and variant according to action hierarchy
Describe the action result in the label
dont: Do not stack several primary buttons in one area
Do not rely on color alone for dangerous actions
